name: Recital B
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 16 October 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2429 as regards origin labelling for fruit and vegetables originating in the non-self-governing territory of Western Sahara
part_text: whereas the proposed delegated regulation does not ensure that fruit and vegetables originating from Western Sahara are clearly identified with their true country of origin, allowing ambiguous labelling that is contrary to Union legislation on food information to consumers;
